## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 12-juan posthumous *yǔlù* of Lù Lǒngqí, compiled by his pupil Chén Jì. The title *sānyútáng* is from Lù's hall-name (his *hào* Sānyú "Three Fish"). The work consolidates Lù's *jiǎngxué* materials into a thematic anthology, complementing the *Dú Zhū suí bǐ* ([KR3a0115](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3a/KR3a0115), his close-reading notes on Zhūzǐ) and *Sōngyáng chāo cún* ([KR3a0117](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3a/KR3a0117), his administrative-period reflections from Sōngyáng).

**Abstract**

The *Sānyútáng shèng yán* is the principal *yǔlù* of Lù Lǒngqí. Composition window: Lù's working life (1670–1692) plus Chén Jì's editorial work (post-1692, completed during Chén's life span 1665–1718). The frontmatter brackets to ca. 1670–1700.

The substantive position is uniformly Zhū-Xī-loyalist, providing the thematic-anthology counterpart to the *Dú Zhū suí bǐ*'s reading-notes form.

The bibliographic record: SKQS *Zǐbù — Rújiā lèi*.
